title: Benchmarking antibody modeling tools across structure prediction, docking, and paratope-epitope interface analysis.
authors: Yu, Zeyuan; Wu, Jilei; Ning, Ziyao; Qiao, Chunxia; Wang, Jing; Li, Xinying; Liu, Chenghua; Chen, Guojiang; Feng, Jiannan; Yu, Jijun
one_liner_zh: 该文系统比较了多种抗体结构预测、对接及界面分析工具的性能，虽为工程化评估而非方法创新，但直接涉及蛋白质结构预测、对接等核心计算问题，对本课题的工具选择与基准测试有参考价值。
abstract: MOTIVATION: Computational antibody engineering requires reliable prediction of antibody variable-fragment structures, antigen-antibody complexes, and binding interfaces. However, publicly available tools for these tasks have rarely been compared across the complete workflow under a controlled and statistically grounded design. RESULTS: We evaluated ImmuneBuilder, IgFold, AlphaFold3, GRAMM, and dyMEAN on 50 non-redundant humanized antibody-antigen complexes using multiple retained predictions and paired statistical testing. All three antibody structure predictors were accurate, with AlphaFold3 performing best overall and for the third complementarity-determining region of the heavy chain. AlphaFold3 also substantially outperformed GRAMM and dyMEAN in complex prediction, producing medium- or high-quality binding interfaces for 46% of the complexes, although overall interface accuracy remained limited. When docking was reliable, AlphaFold3 accurately recovered epitope and paratope residues, salt bridges, and non-bonded contacts, but reproduced hydrogen bonds and fine-grained contact strengths less consistently. These findings provide practical guidance for selecting tools across antibody-modeling workflows and identify persistent limitations in fine-grained interface prediction. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Data, structural predictions, evaluation results, and analysis code are available from Zenodo under record 20710876.
abstract_zh: 动机：计算抗体工程需要对抗体可变区片段结构、抗原-抗体复合物及结合界面进行可靠预测。然而，针对这些任务的公开可用工具，在受控且具有统计基础的设计下，很少在整个工作流程中进行比较。结果：我们使用多个保留预测和配对统计检验，在50个非冗余人源化抗体-抗原复合物上评估了ImmuneBuilder、IgFold、AlphaFold3、GRAMM和dyMEAN。所有三种抗体结构预测器均表现准确，其中AlphaFold3整体表现最佳，且在重链第三互补决定区上表现最优。AlphaFold3在复合物预测方面也显著优于GRAMM和dyMEAN，为46%的复合物生成了中等或高质量的结合界面，尽管整体界面准确性仍然有限。当对接可靠时，AlphaFold3能准确恢复表位和互补位残基、盐桥及非键接触，但在氢键和细粒度接触强度的再现上一致性较差。这些发现为跨抗体建模工作流选择工具提供了实用指导，并识别出细粒度界面预测中持续存在的局限性。可用性与实现：数据、结构预测、评估结果及分析代码可从Zenodo（记录号20710876）获取。
